realm_description: The high, thin-aired peaks where thought is clearest. Those drawn here chase vision, discovery, and the kind of knowledge that only comes from climbing higher than everyone else.

primary.label: Philosopher
primary.description: Chases understanding for its own sake, deeper than any single answer.
primary.guiding_promise: I will not stop asking until the world reveals what it truly is.
primary.shadow_description: Keeps asking the next question until the moment for an answer has already passed.

secondary.label: Historian
secondary.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
secondary.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

wheel.central_question: Should we understand first, or endure first?

growth.label: Historian
growth.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
growth.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
growth.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

other_ally.label: Diplomat
other_ally.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
other_ally.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

quarter.label: Custodian
quarter.description: Refuses to let a tradition, language, or way of life slip away; care is not nostalgia but stubborn devotion.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will hold on to what matters, long after others have let it go.
trait_descriptions: Some things must not be lost.
quarter.shadow_description: Guards the tradition so fiercely that nothing — not even necessary growth — is allowed through.

opposite.label: Survivor
opposite.description: Endures; resilience is the value they hold above all others.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will rise from the ash, proving that our light cannot be crushed.
opposite.shadow_description: Treats every calm moment as the quiet before the next disaster, and lets no one close enough to prove otherwise.

realmmate.label: Visionary
realmmate.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
realmmate.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

wheel.compatible_text: Visionary · Oracle — fellow travelers of The Mountain Belt.
